question: Zeeshan travels 612 km at 68 km/hr, the next 312 km at 39 km/hr and the next 620 km at 62 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey? (Round off your answer to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time taken = (612 ÷ 68) + (312 ÷ 39) + (620 ÷ 62) = 9 + 8 + 10 = 27 hours.

Total distance covered = 612 + 312 + 620 = 1544 km.

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time = 1544 ÷ 27

Average speed ≈ 57.19 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 57.19 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance D₁ = 612 km, Speed S₁ = 68 km/hr

Distance D₂ = 312 km, Speed S₂ = 39 km/hr

Distance D₃ = 620 km, Speed S₃ = 62 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 612 km 312 km 620 km 68 km/hr 39 km/hr 62 km/hr T = 9 hr T = 8 hr T = 10 hr 
• Average Speed = 1544 ÷ 27 ≈ 57.19 km/hr 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 612 + 312 + 620 = 1544 km

⇒ Time for 1st part (T₁) = D₁ ÷ S₁ = 612 ÷ 68 = 9 hours

⇒ Time for 2nd part (T₂) = D₂ ÷ S₂ = 312 ÷ 39 = 8 hours

⇒ Time for 3rd part (T₃) = D₃ ÷ S₃ = 620 ÷ 62 = 10 hours

⇒ Total Time = 9 + 8 + 10 = 27 hours

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 1544 ÷ 27 = 57.185...

⇒ Average Speed ≈ 57.19 km/hr (rounded off to two decimal places)

**∴ The correct answer is 57.19 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average speed is the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken. It provides a single speed value representing the overall journey.

Average Speed for Equal Distances

When a journey consists of two equal distance segments traveled at speeds S₁ and S₂, the average speed is given by the harmonic mean: (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Average Speed for Equal Time Intervals

If an object travels at different speeds for exactly equal time intervals, the overall average speed is simply the arithmetic mean of all individual speeds.
